gloss: to show off; to put on airs

definitions.gloss: to show off; to put on airs; to keep up appearances
definitions.explanation: To act in a way that makes oneself appear better, richer, or more capable than one actually is. Often implies vanity or insecurity.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みえ}を{張|は}らなくて⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: You don't need to show off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{見栄|みえ}を{張|は}って⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: She always buys expensive clothes to keep up appearances.

examples.japanese: {見栄|みえ}を{張|は}って⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you overdo things just to show off, you'll regret it later.

notes:
USAGE:
Carries a negative connotation, suggesting that someone is being pretentious or living beyond their means. Commonly used to gently criticize vanity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見栄|みえ}を{張|は}らない (to not show off, to be unpretentious)
- {見栄|みえ}を{張|は}って⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to overextend oneself to keep up appearances)
- ⟦{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}り→見栄っ張り：20410_mieppari⟧ (show-off; vain person)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Conjugates as a godan verb (⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧). ⟦{見栄|みえ}っ{張|ぱ}り→見栄っ張り：20410_mieppari⟧ is a related noun/adjective meaning "vain" or "showy."
